name: Attention-velocity ignition — fast accel scalp with vol guard (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the fastest expression of attention-onset — an accel z-spike on the 1h bar, taken only when realized vol is not already blown out (vol_realized ceiling) so we buy the ignition, not the exhaustion tail. On small floats the CHANGE in attention leads the very-short-horizon move as fresh eyeballs hit before order flow. Counterparty is dashboard-lagged retail. DISCONFIRMER: at 1h cadence the daily social source may be stale-repeated within the bar — if lead-lag shows the effect is symmetric (equal at -1 and +1) the signal is interpolation/look-ahead, KILL. Shuffle-test the attention series. Must clear 1h round-trip fees, which is a high bar at this turnover.
catalyst: sharp intrabar attention acceleration into contained volatility
